description: This source file defines the class 'XLinearGradientBrush', which represents a linear gradient brush used for drawing in the PdfSharp library. It includes multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios, methods for transforming the brush, and platform-specific logic for rendering the brush using GDI, WPF, or WUI backends.

classes.name: XLinearGradientBrush
classes.description: A sealed class that defines a brush with a linear gradient, supporting various initialization options and platform-specific rendering.

methods.name: XLinearGradientBrush
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the brush with points, rectangle, colors, and gradient mode.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Property to get or set the transformation matrix of the brush.

methods.name: MultiplyTransform
methods.description: Multiplies the brush transform matrix with another matrix.

methods.name: ResetTransform
methods.description: Resets the brush transform to identity.
